capabilities.name: List files inside archive
capabilities.description: List all entries inside a ZIP/TAR/RAR/7z archive without extracting them.

capabilities.name: Read a member file inside archive
capabilities.description: Read a specified inner document from an archive directly.
capabilities.output_shape: Text content of the inner document.

capabilities.name: Read CSV
capabilities.description: Read a CSV file with encoding fallback.

capabilities.name: Read DOCX
capabilities.description: Read a DOCX file's paragraph text and embedded images.
capabilities.output_shape: Paragraph text and image binary content.

capabilities.name: Read HTML body text
capabilities.description: Extract the main body text from an HTML/HTM file.
capabilities.output_shape: Plain text of the body content.

capabilities.name: Read image document
capabilities.description: Read an image of a document (photo, scan, screenshot) and obtain its visible content.
capabilities.input_shape: An image file (png/jpg/screenshot) of a document.
capabilities.output_shape: Visible text and visual structure observed in the image.

capabilities.name: Read JSON file
capabilities.description: Read a JSON file from disk and parse its contents.

capabilities.name: Read Markdown
capabilities.description: Read a Markdown file.

capabilities.name: Read ODT
capabilities.description: Read text content from an OpenDocument Text file.

capabilities.name: Read PDF
capabilities.description: Read a PDF document and obtain its text and structural content.
capabilities.output_shape: Text content and structure of the PDF.

capabilities.name: Read PPTX
capabilities.description: Read a PowerPoint file and produce per-slide content.

capabilities.name: Read RTF
capabilities.description: Read text content from a Rich Text Format file.

capabilities.name: Read tabular/log file
capabilities.description: Load a tabular log file (timeline JSON) into memory for downstream rendering.

capabilities.name: Read XLSX
capabilities.description: Read an Excel workbook and produce per-sheet table content.
capabilities.output_shape: Per-sheet table text or structured data.

capabilities.name: Extract form fields
capabilities.description: Enumerate every fillable field on a form with label, type, required flag, section, and conditional triggers.
capabilities.input_shape: A form document image or PDF.
capabilities.output_shape: A list of field objects with metadata.

capabilities.name: Extract identity-document fields
capabilities.description: Extract the standard biographic fields from an identity document (passport, national ID, driver's license).
capabilities.output_shape: A structured set of identity fields per document type.

capabilities.name: Decode MRZ
capabilities.description: Decode TD1/TD2/TD3 MRZ strings into structured fields by character position.
capabilities.input_shape: Raw MRZ lines or an identity image with MRZ.
capabilities.output_shape: Structured MRZ fields with positional values.

capabilities.name: Fuzzy inner filename selection
capabilities.description: Select the best matching inner file name using case-insensitive fuzzy matching when no exact match exists.

capabilities.name: Transform DOCX to Markdown
capabilities.description: Convert DOCX content into Markdown preserving headings/lists/inline.

capabilities.name: Filter rows by criterion
capabilities.description: Select a subset of rows matching a filter argument and report matched vs total counts.

capabilities.name: Transform HTML to Markdown
capabilities.description: Convert HTML into Markdown preserving structure and links.

capabilities.name: Transform JSON to tabular
capabilities.description: Map JSON structures into multi-sheet tabular layouts.
capabilities.output_shape: Tabular data optionally keyed by sheet.

capabilities.name: Transform Markdown to DOCX AST
capabilities.description: Convert Markdown structure into DOCX-compatible document AST preserving headings/lists/inline.

capabilities.name: Transform Markdown to HTML
capabilities.description: Convert Markdown into HTML preserving structure.

capabilities.name: Mask PII in identity fields
capabilities.description: Mask document/ID/personal numbers (e.g., XXXXX{last3}) in extracted output.
capabilities.input_shape: Extracted identity fields including sensitive numbers.
capabilities.output_shape: Same fields with sensitive numbers masked.

capabilities.name: Rasterize PDF pages to images
capabilities.description: Render PDF pages as raster images.

capabilities.name: Render tabular data as image
capabilities.description: Render tabular data into a raster image visually representing the table.
capabilities.output_shape: An in-memory image of the table.

capabilities.name: Convert tabular data to JSON
capabilities.description: Map rows of tabular data into a JSON object/array structure.
capabilities.output_shape: JSON value preserving values per row.

capabilities.name: Render tabular data as Markdown table
capabilities.description: Convert tabular data into a Markdown table layout.
capabilities.input_shape: Rows and columns of tabular data.
capabilities.output_shape: A Markdown table with specified columns.

capabilities.name: Render tabular data as Markdown report
capabilities.description: Convert log/tabular entries plus a summary into a structured Markdown report excluding sensitive content.
capabilities.output_shape: A Markdown report with entries and summary.

capabilities.name: Aggregate tabular data into statistics
capabilities.description: Compute counts, top/bottom items, first/last entries, and per-key breakdowns from tabular data.

capabilities.name: Reformat tabular data
capabilities.description: Convert tabular data between CSV/Excel layouts preserving rows and columns.
capabilities.output_shape: Tabular data ready for the target writer.

capabilities.name: Render tabular content as text
capabilities.description: Render tabular spreadsheet data as flat text, optionally per-sheet.

capabilities.name: Transform plain text to tabular
capabilities.description: Parse delimited text into tabular rows/columns.

capabilities.name: Classify content
capabilities.description: Assign a category label to content based on signals/keywords/structure.
capabilities.input_shape: Document or content with classification signals.
capabilities.output_shape: A category label drawn from a defined taxonomy.

capabilities.name: Rewrite clause to mitigate risk
capabilities.description: Generate replacement contractual language that mitigates an identified risk.
capabilities.input_shape: A flagged clause and its risk type.
capabilities.output_shape: A replacement clause as a quoted text block.

capabilities.name: Assess classification confidence
capabilities.description: Score the confidence of a classification and choose a downstream action flow.
capabilities.input_shape: A classification result with its supporting signals.
capabilities.output_shape: A confidence label and selected action decision.

capabilities.name: Apply natural-language conversion instruction
capabilities.description: Interpret a natural-language instruction (rename fields, extract tables, split content) and apply it during conversion.
capabilities.input_shape: Source content and a natural-language instruction.

capabilities.name: Generate scoped data-collection prompt
capabilities.description: Produce a user-facing data request prompt scoped strictly to fields actually present on the form.
capabilities.input_shape: Extracted field list and collection mode.
capabilities.output_shape: A prompt requesting only relevant data with notice.

capabilities.name: Derive computed field values
capabilities.description: Compute values such as Age from DOB or duration from arrival/departure dates.

capabilities.name: Identify risks/issues in content
capabilities.description: Detect risk patterns, traps, or issues in a document and assign severity.
capabilities.input_shape: A full document plus a risk-pattern catalog.
capabilities.output_shape: List of findings with severity, location, recommendation.

capabilities.name: Summarize content
capabilities.description: Produce a plain-language summary covering required topics from a document.
capabilities.output_shape: A bullet or prose summary of required topics.

capabilities.name: Translate text
capabilities.description: Translate natural-language text from a source language to a target language while preserving meaning and protected tokens.
capabilities.input_shape: Text in source language with terminology and protection rules.
capabilities.output_shape: Text in target language with protected tokens preserved.

capabilities.name: Preserve original DOCX content
capabilities.description: Ensure annotations do not modify the original document content beyond adding highlight marks.
capabilities.output_shape: Annotated DOCX with original content intact.

capabilities.name: Preserve protected tokens
capabilities.description: Keep brand names, trademarks, numbers+units, footnote symbols, and format placeholders unchanged across translation.
capabilities.input_shape: Source text with protected token rules.
capabilities.output_shape: Translated text with protected tokens preserved verbatim.

capabilities.name: Preserve DOCX styles
capabilities.description: Keep word/styles.xml and run/paragraph styling intact during translation.

capabilities.name: Preserve PPTX template/style
capabilities.description: Keep theme, master, and content-type structures of the original presentation intact during translation.

capabilities.name: Preserve XLSX styles
capabilities.description: Keep xl/styles.xml and worksheet formatting intact during translation.

capabilities.name: Match user data to form fields via aliases
capabilities.description: Map user-provided data fields to form labels using alias tables, choosing the most specific match.
capabilities.input_shape: Form field list and user profile data with alias tables.

capabilities.name: Cross-field consistency comparison
capabilities.description: Compare related fields (e.g., DOB-derived age vs Age field; expiry vs travel-date rule) to detect inconsistencies.
capabilities.input_shape: Multiple related fields with computable derivations.

capabilities.name: Compare two documents for duplicates
capabilities.description: Compare paragraph text across two DOCX documents (exact or fuzzy similarity) to find duplicates.
capabilities.input_shape: Two parsed DOCX paragraph sets and a comparison mode/threshold.
capabilities.output_shape: List of duplicate paragraph pairs with similarity scores.

capabilities.name: Compare images by content hash
capabilities.description: Detect identical images across documents by computing and comparing MD5 hashes of image bytes.
capabilities.input_shape: Image binaries extracted from two documents.
capabilities.output_shape: Pairs of images with identical hashes.

capabilities.name: Run batch conversion across files
capabilities.description: Iterate a list of files, converting each to the requested target format and collecting per-file results.
capabilities.input_shape: A list of files and a target format.
capabilities.output_shape: A set of converted output files plus a per-file status report.

capabilities.name: Compose PDF from images
capabilities.description: Combine multiple images into a single PDF document.

capabilities.name: Assemble multi-section report
capabilities.description: Compose multiple analysis fragments into a final structured report following a template.
capabilities.input_shape: Multiple analysis fragments (summary, findings, checks, scores).
capabilities.output_shape: A single formatted report with header and sections.

capabilities.name: Run checklist validation
capabilities.description: Check whether a document satisfies a list of required items/clauses.
capabilities.input_shape: A document and a domain-specific checklist.

capabilities.name: Validate field values
capabilities.description: Apply format and consistency rules (date format, regex shape, future-date logic, cross-field consistency) to filled values.
capabilities.input_shape: A field-to-value mapping with validation rules.

capabilities.name: Validate format support and integrity
capabilities.description: Detect unsupported formats and corrupted files; route to friendly error messaging instead of failing the batch.
capabilities.input_shape: An input file and target format.
capabilities.output_shape: Pass/fail with reason for unsupported or corrupted inputs.

capabilities.name: Verify MRZ check digits
capabilities.description: Compute and verify MRZ check digits using the 7-3-1 weighting algorithm.
capabilities.input_shape: Decoded MRZ fields with raw substrings and positions.

capabilities.name: Validate that output contains no PII
capabilities.description: Ensure a generated text contains only category-level descriptions and no PII.
capabilities.output_shape: Pass/fail PII check with offending tokens if any.

capabilities.name: Write CSV
capabilities.description: Write tabular data into a CSV file.

capabilities.name: Write annotated DOCX
capabilities.description: Write a DOCX output that contains highlight/annotation marks layered on the original content.
capabilities.input_shape: Original DOCX content and a list of annotations.

capabilities.name: Write HTML
capabilities.description: Write content into an HTML file.

capabilities.name: Write image file
capabilities.description: Write rasterized content into a PNG or JPG image file.
capabilities.input_shape: An in-memory rendering and target format.

capabilities.name: Write JSON file
capabilities.description: Serialize structured data into a JSON file.
capabilities.output_shape: A .json file at the target path.

capabilities.name: Write/update JSON log file
capabilities.description: Append, modify, or clear entries in a JSON log file with field schema preservation.

capabilities.name: Write Markdown file
capabilities.description: Write structured content into a Markdown file.
capabilities.input_shape: Structured content with headings, tables, lists.

capabilities.name: Write PDF
capabilities.description: Produce a PDF output containing translated text via Word→PDF rebuild or direct overlay.
capabilities.input_shape: Translated text plus source layout (or interim DOCX).
capabilities.output_shape: A .pdf file at the target path.

capabilities.name: Write PPTX
capabilities.description: Write back a PPTX archive with translated text nodes inserted.
capabilities.input_shape: Original PPTX structure plus translated text nodes.
capabilities.output_shape: A .pptx file at the target path.

capabilities.name: Write text/report output
capabilities.description: Render a structured analysis or message as a textual output.

capabilities.name: Write plain-text comparison report
capabilities.description: Write a detailed comparison/duplicate report as a plain-text file.

capabilities.name: Write XLSX
capabilities.description: Write back an XLSX archive with translated shared strings.
capabilities.input_shape: Original XLSX structure plus translated shared strings.
capabilities.output_shape: A .xlsx file at the target path.
